## Goal
- Complete the reviewed IVX IA chat/auth release to production and provide verifiable live deployment evidence without exposing secrets.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do not use or request the legacy static owner token.
- Preserve Supabase JWT owner authorization; do not weaken direct-owner controls.
- Keep signed server-to-server worker authorization separate: HMAC, expiring single-use owner approval, exact action/SHA binding.
- Never print, commit, or expose secret values.
- Public-chat policy blocks must return renderable HTTP `200` turns; authorization failures remain `401`/`403`; use `409` only for genuine state conflicts.
- Do not claim production deployment or verification without live evidence.
- Keep unrelated `.rork/history/main/*.json` and `ios-ivx-holdings/` work out of the backend release.

## Progress
### Done
- Local signed-deployment authorization implementation is complete:
  - `backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-auth.ts` validates HMAC-SHA256 over worker ID, timestamp, nonce, method, path, and raw body.
  - Enforces five-minute clock skew, constant-time signature comparison, nonce replay prevention, exact approval/SHA/action binding, and single-use approval consumption.
  - Uses injectable `InternalDeployAuthStore` for isolated tests.
- Local public-chat policy-block rendering fix is present:
  - `backend/api/public-chat.ts` persists feasibility blocks and returns a completed renderable HTTP `200` response.
  - `backend/services/ivx-public-chat-gate-response.ts` formats visible blocker responses.
- Owner approval API and route wiring are present locally:
  - `backend/api/ivx-deployment-approvals.ts`
  - `POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/deployment-approvals`
  - Signed-worker integration in `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`.
- Focused validation succeeded:
  - `bun test backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-auth.test.ts backend/services/ivx-public-chat-gate-response.test.ts backend/services/ivx-pre-execution-feasibility-gate.test.ts` exited `0`.
  - Focused suite includes auth signature, expiry, nonce replay, approval mismatch, single-use consumption, public formatter, and feasibility-gate coverage.
  - `ios-ivx-holdings` build check passed previously; it remains outside this backend release scope.
- Production evidence refreshed:
  - `https://api.ivxholding.com/health` returned `ok:true`, `status:"healthy"`.
  - Live runtime reports GitHub read/push and Render deployment capabilities available.
  - GitHub `main` is `934e7e5eb7436d0a56b9b1974abf0a870110f848`, message `release: publish validated IVX iOS source`.
  - Render service `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0` has live deployment commit `934e7e5eb7436d0a56b9b1974abf0a870110f848`.
- Confirmed a real Supabase owner bearer can access the existing protected worker status endpoint:
  - `GET /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/status` returned HTTP `200` with `{ "ok": true, "ownerOnly": true, "marker": "ivx-senior-developer-worker-2026-07-17" }`.
  - Unauthenticated status request correctly returned HTTP `401`.
- Render topology audit completed:
  - `ivx-holdings-platform` (`srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`) is the only API web service.
  - `ivx-holdings-chat-frontend` is a static site.
  - No Render service named `ivx-senior-dev-01` exists.
- Release evidence ledger was updated in `.rork/plans/force-sync-ivx-workspace-and-release-eve_1784928084433.plan.md`.
- Local current branch is ahead of `origin/main` by `21` commits:
  - Current local `HEAD`: `7eb1cd73` (`New version from Rork`).
  - Relevant implementation commits include `8e051f30` (`Finalize secure deployment for IVX chat fixes.`) and `adf76292` (`Completed app improvements and enhanced the automated update system's security.`).

### In Progress
- Publish only the reviewed IVX chat/auth/worker-manifest source from local `main` to GitHub `main`.
- Deploy the published revision through Render and verify SHA parity.
- Verify the live public-chat `"deploy now"` behavior after production receives the patch.
- Determine/provision the actual autonomous worker hosting path and its private HMAC configuration.

### Blocked
- No production deployment has occurred for the reviewed local commits:
  - GitHub `main`, live API runtime, and live Render deployment remain at `934e7e5eb7436d0a56b9b1974abf0a870110f848`.
- The configured worker identity `ivx-senior-dev-01` has no corresponding Render service.
- `IVX_INTERNAL_DEPLOY_SECRET` and `IVX_INTERNAL_WORKER_ID` are not confirmed as configured on the production API and no worker service exists to receive matching configuration.
- Full repository typecheck remains blocked by unrelated existing errors, including:
  - `backend/api/ivx-investor-performance.ts(82,39): error TS2339: Property 'totalDistributions' does not exist on type 'AccountSummary'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-investor-performance.ts(114,23): error TS2339: Property 'id' does not exist on type 'LedgerEntry'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts(7712,9): error TS2322: Type '"ivx_qa_only_runtime"' is not assignable...`
  - `backend/hono.ts(5059,28): error TS2554: Expected 2 arguments, but got 1.`
- `.rork/history/main/*.json` continues to receive workspace-history modifications and must not be released.

## Key Decisions
- Retain `assertIVXRegisteredOwnerBearer()` / `resolveIVXAuthenticatedRequest()` for direct human owner actions.
- Use HMAC authorization only for the internal worker path; do not substitute it for user JWT authorization.
- Require exact `ownerApprovalId`, `requestedCommitSha`, and `deploymentAction` matching before consuming an approval.
- Validate signatures before mutating nonce/approval state so invalid requests cannot consume approvals.
- Use injected `InternalDeployAuthStore` in tests rather than module mocking.
- Return public-chat feasibility blocks as stored, visible HTTP `200` assistant turns rather than HTTP `409`.
- Keep production secrets exclusively in private Render environment variables; never source control.
- Do not state that IVX IA chat is fully deployed until GitHub, Render, live runtime SHA, and public-chat probe all confirm the reviewed revision.

## Next Steps
1. Remove/exclude `.rork/history/main/*.json` from any release commit and identify the exact reviewed source commit range.
2. Push the reviewed chat/auth/backend/`render.yaml` changes from local `main` to `ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest` `main`.
3. Trigger or wait for Render deployment of `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`; poll until status is `live`.
4. Verify GitHub `main`, Render deployment metadata, `/health`, and runtime commit SHA all match the newly published SHA.
5. Run live `POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/public/chat` with `{"message":"deploy now"}` and record HTTP `200`, `ok:true`, and visible `answer`.
6. Provision or identify the real autonomous worker service; configure a fresh private `IVX_INTERNAL_DEPLOY_SECRET` and `IVX_INTERNAL_WORKER_ID=ivx-senior-dev-01` on both ends.
7. With a real owner Supabase JWT, create a short-lived deployment approval and verify one signed worker request consumes it exactly once.
8. Add final commit SHA, Render deployment ID, health output, chat result, and signed-worker proof to `.rork/plans/force-sync-ivx-workspace-and-release-eve_1784928084433.plan.md`.

## Critical Context
- User explicitly requested: “complete deployment now provide proof evidence and verified live now.”
- This request has not yet been fulfilled; available live evidence proves the old release is healthy, not that the reviewed chat fix is deployed.
- Live production:
  - GitHub SHA: `934e7e5eb7436d0a56b9b1974abf0a870110f848`
  - Render service: `ivx-holdings-platform`
  - Render ID: `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`
  - Current Render deployment status: `live`
  - Current Render deployment commit: `934e7e5eb7436d0a56b9b1974abf0a870110f848`
- Local branch:
  - `HEAD`: `7eb1cd73`
  - Branch state: `main ... [origin/main: ahead 21]`
  - Relevant source commits:
    - `8e051f30 Finalize secure deployment for IVX chat fixes.`
    - `adf76292 Completed app improvements and enhanced the automated update system's security.`
- Existing production public chat previously returned HTTP `409` for `{"message":"deploy now"}` with feasibility `BLOCKED`, `OWNER_SESSION_MISSING`, and no renderable `answer`; the local fix has not been proven live yet.
- The production worker status endpoint exists and correctly protects access:
  - No bearer: HTTP `401`.
  - Valid owner bearer: HTTP `200`.
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-dev-worker.ts` describes an independent long-running worker requiring Supabase, GitHub, Render, and AI credentials, but the actual Render worker service is absent.
- Signed worker request requirements:
  - JSON: `ownerApprovalId`, `requestedCommitSha`, `deploymentAction`
  - `deploymentAction`: `GITHUB_WRITE`, `RENDER_DEPLOY`, or `PRODUCTION_DEPLOY`
  - Headers: `X-IVX-Worker-ID`, `X-IVX-Timestamp`, `X-IVX-Nonce`, `X-IVX-Deploy-Signature`
- Avoid displaying credential values even though credentials are available in the execution environment.

## Relevant Files

- `backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-auth.ts`: HMAC validation, nonce handling, durable approvals, and single-use consumption.
- `backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-auth.test.ts`: Focused auth regression coverage using injected in-memory storage.
- `backend/api/ivx-deployment-approvals.ts`: Owner-JWT route for short-lived signed-worker deployment approvals.
- `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`: Direct-owner and signed-internal-worker job authorization surface.

- `render.yaml`: Production manifest; worker definition must be reconciled with actual Render topology.
- `.rork/history/main/*.json`: Workspace-history changes; exclude from release.
- `ios-ivx-holdings/`: Unrelated Swift app; build passed but exclude from backend deployment.
